project_name: Multi-Agent Market Research and Report Generator

observed_task_assignments.task: Delegate this task to the Market Research Specialist. Research the following market topic: Tech Sector Q3 Analysis. Identify industry trends, major companies, competitors, market opportunities and challenges. Use web search and website scraping tools. Include relevant source URLs and avoid inventing facts.

Delegate this task to the Financial Data Analyst. Analyse data/sample_financial_data.csv using the Financial Data Analysis Tool. Calculate revenue, profit and market-share statistics. Explain findings.

Delegate this task to the Professional Report Writer. Prepare a professional market research report using the market research findings and financial analysis. Include executive summary, industry overview, trends, competitor analysis, financial analysis, opportunities, risks and conclusion. Clearly distinguish illustrative financial data from verified market information.
